battle.name: 英桑戰爭
battle.brief: 一八九六年八月二十七日，桑給巴爾蘇丹拒絕英國最後通牒，英軍以巡洋艦與砲艇自海上炮擊桑給巴爾城海濱王宮，四十分鐘即告結束。卡面鐵甲艦生於一八六二年——那年它首次實戰，並在漢普頓路德灣互撼；到一八九六年，鐵甲艦已退出英國海軍名冊，擔任火力的是它的鋼骨後代。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰一方是大不列顛王國，以桑給巴爾保護國宗主的身分介入，火力由皇家海軍東印度分隊承擔，總司令為海軍少將哈里·羅森，旗艦是一八九二年下水的埃德加級防護巡洋艦聖喬治號；港內另有珍珠級巡洋艦菲洛墨拉號、射手級巡洋艦浣熊號，以及紅胸級砲艇畫眉號與麻雀號。英方陸上兵力由兩部分組成：駐桑給巴爾領事兼外交專員巴茲爾·凱夫管轄的領事館與警察，以及由威爾特郡團中尉亞瑟·雷克斯以准將軍銜率領的九百名桑給巴爾非洲民兵；另有自菲洛墨拉號與畫眉號上岸的水兵及海軍陸戰隊員一百五十人。另一方是桑給巴爾蘇丹國：蘇丹哈立德·本·巴伽什未經英方同意自行即位，指揮系統極度扁平，宮廷衛隊指揮薩利赫上尉直接控制王宮廣場的守軍，總數約二千八百人，其中七百名為擁護他的阿斯卡里士兵；火力為數門馬克沁與加特林機槍、一門十七世紀銅製加農炮與兩門德皇威廉二世所贈的十二磅野戰炮，海上則是皇家遊艇格拉斯哥號與兩艘蒸汽快艇。德國並非交戰方，卻因領事館庇護與接應逃亡而直接介入。英方的行動則由倫敦索爾茲伯里勳爵內閣以電報授權。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the United Kingdom, acting as the protecting power over Zanzibar. The firepower was carried by the Royal Navy's East Indies Station under Rear-Admiral Harry Rawson, whose flagship was the Edgar-class protected cruiser HMS St George, launched in 1892; the harbour also held the Pearl-class cruiser HMS Philomel, the Archer-class cruiser HMS Racoon, and the Redbreast-class gunboats HMS Thrush and HMS Sparrow. Britain's land element had two parts: the consulate and its police under Basil Cave, consul and diplomatic agent in Zanzibar, and nine hundred Zanzibari askaris commanded by Lieutenant Arthur Raikes of the Wiltshire Regiment, seconded to the Zanzibar Army and holding the rank of brigadier-general; a further hundred and fifty sailors and marines were landed from Philomel and Thrush. The other belligerent was the Sultanate of Zanzibar. Sultan Khalid bin Barghash had taken the throne without British consent, and his command system was extremely flat: Captain Saleh of the palace bodyguard directly controlled the force massed in the Palace Square, some 2,800 men, of whom 700 were askari soldiers who had thrown in their lot with him; his weapons were several Maxim and Gatling machine guns, one seventeenth-century bronze cannon and two twelve-pounder field guns presented by the German emperor Wilhelm II, and at sea the royal yacht HHS Glasgow with two steam launches. Germany was not a belligerent, yet it intervened directly by sheltering the fugitive sultan in its consulate and carrying him away. The British action had been authorised by Lord Salisbury's government in London by telegram.
people: 一八九六年八月二十五日十一時四十分（東非時間），在位三年的蘇丹哈馬德·本·杜威尼突然去世；二十九歲的姪子哈立德·本·巴伽什在未取得英方同意下進駐海濱王宮，並於同日十四時三十分以宮禮炮正式宣布即位。英方屬意較親英的哈茂德·本·穆罕默德。總指揮是勞埃德·馬修斯：他是前皇家海軍上尉，現任桑給巴爾陸軍總司令兼首席部長，九時整下令英艦開火。海軍少將哈里·羅森身為東印度分隊總司令，於八時五十五分在聖喬治號升起「準備戰鬥」旗號，主持整場炮擊。駐桑給巴爾領事兼外交專員巴茲爾·凱夫負責談判與最後通牒，並在倫敦授權到手前去電請示可否開火；前任總領事倫內爾·羅德曾於一八九三年以利害相勸說服哈立德放棄王位，這回未能奏效。宮廷衛隊指揮薩利赫上尉是守方的主要軍事人物；雷克斯准將則率領英方唯一遭到還擊的陸軍部隊。海軍陸戰隊與水兵由奧卡拉漢上尉率領上岸，隨後參與消防。哈立德本人由德國領事阿爾布雷希特·馮·雷興貝格庇護，最終於十月二日轉乘德國海軍海鷹號離開；一九一六年他在東非戰役中被英軍俘獲，囚於塞舌爾與聖赫勒拿，一九二七年卒於蒙巴薩。
peopleEn: At 11:40 East Africa time on 25 August 1896 Sultan Hamad bin Thuwaini, who had reigned for three years, died suddenly; his twenty-nine-year-old nephew Khalid bin Barghash moved into the seafront palace without British consent and formally proclaimed himself sultan the same day at 14:30, to the salute of the palace guns. The British preferred Hamoud bin Muhammed, who was more friendly to them. The overall commander was Lloyd Mathews, a former lieutenant of the Royal Navy who was now commander of the Zanzibar army and first minister; at nine o'clock he ordered the British ships to open fire. Rear-Admiral Harry Rawson, commander-in-chief of the East Indies Station, hoisted the signal to prepare for action aboard St George at 08:55 and directed the whole bombardment. Basil Cave, consul and diplomatic agent in Zanzibar, handled the negotiations and the ultimatum and cabled London for authority to fire before the order came; Rennell Rodd, the former consul-general, had in 1893 talked Khalid out of the throne with a plain statement of the risks, and on this occasion the same words had no effect. Captain Saleh of the palace bodyguard was the principal military figure on the defending side; Brigadier-General Raikes commanded the only British land troops that were actually fired upon. The marines and sailors were put ashore under Captain O'Callaghan and afterwards took part in fire fighting. Khalid himself was sheltered by the German consul Albrecht von Rechenberg and finally left on the German gunboat SMS Seeadler on 2 October; in 1916 he was taken by British forces during the East African Campaign, was exiled to Seychelles and Saint Helena, and died at Mombasa in 1927.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是一八六二年的木殼包鐵戰艦。鐵甲艦這一艦型自一八五九年法國的光榮號問世，至一八九〇年代初便告退場；一八六二年正是它首次投入實戰的一年，同年三月九日漢普頓路德灣爆發史上第一場鐵甲艦對鐵甲艦之戰，裝甲配合高爆砲自此改寫海戰規則。及至一八九六年，這類艦隻早已從英國海軍名冊上消失，艦名改稱戰列艦或裝甲巡洋艦，承擔火力的已是聖喬治號那一類鋼骨防護巡洋艦：埃德加級主武裝為兩門九點二吋後膛砲與十門六吋速射砲，另有十二門六磅霍奇基斯速射砲與四具十八吋魚雷管，擊發的正是能撕開木構的延時引信高爆彈。守方的裝備則停在更早一代：皇家遊艇格拉斯哥號是一八七八年仿照英國巡防艦設計建造的木殼單桅縱帆船，僅裝七門九磅砲與一挺維多利亞女王所贈的加特林機槍；岸上是十七世紀銅砲與兩門德製十二磅野戰炮，另有馬克沁與加特林機槍；雷克斯的民兵配兩挺馬克沁與一門加農砲（英方記錄作九磅，中文史料作八磅）。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a wooden-hulled warship under an iron skin, of 1862. The ironclad type ran from the launch of the French Gloire in 1859 to the early 1890s, and 1862 was the year it first saw combat: on 9 March of that year the Battle of Hampton Roads produced the first engagement between ironclads, and armour combined with the explosive shell rewrote the rules of naval warfare from that point on. By 1896 the type had long since left the Royal Navy's list, the name ironclad having fallen out of use in favour of battleship and armoured cruiser, and the firepower in Zanzibar belonged to the descendants of the type rather than to the type itself: a protected cruiser built of steel, of the kind of HMS St George. The Edgar class carried two 9.2-inch breech-loading guns and ten 6-inch quick-firing guns, together with twelve 6-pounder Hotchkiss guns and four 18-inch torpedo tubes, and fired exactly the high-explosive shells with delay fuses that could tear through timber. The defenders, by contrast, were equipped a full generation earlier: the royal yacht Glasgow, built in 1878 to a British frigate design, was a wooden single-masted schooner carrying only seven nine-pounder guns and one Gatling gun presented by Queen Victoria; on shore stood a seventeenth-century bronze cannon, two German twelve-pounder field guns, and Maxim and Gatling machine guns; and Raikes' askaris had two Maxim guns and one cannon recorded by the British as a nine-pounder and by Chinese sources as an eight-pounder.
tactics: 英方的整套動作是一套成熟的砲艦外交程序。二十六日下午，港內商船被清空，英國婦孺撤上聖喬治號與一艘英印輪船公司船隻，領事館則由水兵看守；當夜桑給巴爾城異常寂靜，連鼓聲與孩童哭聲都無。二十七日八時整，蘇丹遣使議商，凱夫答以唯有接受最後通牒方能得免；八時三十分再傳話，稱無意撤旗；八時五十五分王宮仍無回覆，羅森遂在聖喬治號升起「準備戰鬥」旗號。九時整馬修斯下令開火，九時零二分浣熊號、畫眉號與麻雀號同時齊射，畫眉號的第一發砲彈即擊毀一門瞄準英艦的十二磅砲。守方以木箱、柴草與橡膠袋築起路障，但木構建築在延時引信高爆彈面前形同虛設，宮殿與後宮同時起火，砲位相繼失效。陸上，海軍陸戰隊與水兵在受命後十五分鐘內完成上岸，在海關一帶布防；九百名桑給巴爾民兵在海軍火力掩護下由海關向王宮逼近，是全場唯一遭到守方還擊的陸軍部隊。海上另有小戰：九時零五分，格拉斯哥號以七門九磅砲與一挺加特林射擊聖喬治號，隨即被擊沉，因港水淺，桅杆仍露在水面之上，船上人員由英方小艇救起；畫眉號亦擊沉兩艘對它開火還擊的桑給巴爾蒸汽快艇。各艦停火時刻記錄不一，旗被擊落後戰事即告結束，隨後英方轉入消防、巡邏與追捕哈立德，並派兵監視德國領事館出入口。
tacticsEn: The British side worked to a settled formula of gunboat diplomacy. On the afternoon of the 26th the harbour was cleared of merchant shipping, the British women and children were moved aboard St George and a vessel of the British India Steam Navigation Company, and the consulate was guarded by sailors; that night Zanzibar Town was unnaturally silent, without the drums or the crying of children that normally carried across it. At 08:00 on the 27th the sultan sent an envoy to parley, and Cave answered that salvation lay only in accepting the ultimatum; at 08:30 another messenger declared that there was no intention of hauling down the flag; at 08:55 no word came from the palace, so Rawson hoisted the signal to prepare for action aboard St George. At nine o'clock Mathews ordered the ships to fire, and at 09:02 Racoon, Thrush and Sparrow opened fire simultaneously, the first shot from Thrush dismounting a twelve-pounder that had been trained on the British ships. The defenders built barricades of crates, bales and rubber, but timber construction was nothing against high-explosive shells with delay fuses: the palace and the harem took fire and the batteries were silenced in turn. Ashore, marines and sailors completed their landing within fifteen minutes of the order and took up positions around the customs house, while nine hundred Zanzibari askaris moved from the customs house towards the palace under naval covering fire, and were the only British land troops fired upon by the defenders. A small engagement took place at sea: at 09:05 the obsolete Glasgow opened on St George with her seven nine-pounders and a Gatling gun and was promptly sunk, her masts still standing out of the water in the shallow harbour, her people rescued by British boats; Thrush in turn sank two Zanzibari steam launches that had fired on her with rifles. The ships recorded the moment of cease fire differently, and once the flag had been shot down the fighting was over; the British then turned to fire fighting, patrolling and the pursuit of Khalid, with men posted outside the German consulate to watch its entrances.
data: 時間線極為緊湊：八月二十五日十一時四十分蘇丹去世，二十六日十時浣熊號進港、十四時聖喬治號進港，二十七日九時零二分開火，九時三十五至四十五分各艦先後記錄停火。兵力方面，英方陸上約一千零五十人，包括九百名桑給巴爾民兵與一百五十名水兵及海軍陸戰隊員；海上英方出動兩艘巡洋艦與三艘砲艇，聖喬治號、菲洛墨拉號、浣熊號、畫眉號與麻雀號當時均在港內。守方約二千八百人，其中七百名為阿斯卡里士兵，配四門火砲與一處岸防砲位，海上為格拉斯哥號與兩艘蒸汽快艇。英方在整場戰鬥中消耗約五百發砲彈、四千一百發機槍彈與一千發步槍彈。傷亡方面，英方僅一人重傷，是畫眉號上一名士官，後得康復；桑給巴爾方面的官方記錄為傷亡約五百人，其中多數死於王宮大火，守方砲兵被稱為全毀，至於戰死與非戰死之分無從分辨。戰後英方要求賠款三十萬盧比，用以償付所耗彈藥與劫掠損失。此外，十月二日十時德國海軍海鷹號抵港接走哈立德；一八九一年桑給巴爾奴隸總數約六萬，廢奴之後十年內獲解放者僅一萬七千二百九十三人。
dataEn: The chronology is extremely tight: the sultan died at 11:40 on 25 August, Racoon entered the harbour at 10:00 on the 26th and St George at 14:00, fire was opened at 09:02 on the 27th, and the ships logged the cease fire at some point between 09:35 and 09:45. On strengths, the British fielded about 1,050 men ashore, comprising nine hundred Zanzibari askaris and a hundred and fifty sailors and marines; at sea they put two cruisers and three gunboats into action, with St George, Philomel, Racoon, Thrush and Sparrow all lying in the harbour. The defenders numbered some 2,800 men, of whom 700 were askari soldiers, with four pieces of artillery and one shore battery, and at sea the royal yacht Glasgow with two steam launches. The British expended roughly five hundred shells, 4,100 machine gun rounds and a thousand rifle rounds over the action. On casualties, the British lost one man, a petty officer of Thrush who was severely wounded and later recovered; the official Zanzibari return was about five hundred killed or wounded, most of the dead perishing in the palace fire, and the defenders' gun crews described as decimated, though the split between combatants and others is unknown. After the war the British demanded reparations of 300,000 rupees to cover the shells expended and the damage of the looting. Two further figures belong to the aftermath: the German gunboat SMS Seeadler arrived at 10:00 on 2 October to take Khalid away, and of an estimated sixty thousand slaves in Zanzibar in 1891 only 17,293 had been emancipated within ten years of the abolition.
cause: 直接起因是王位繼承。一八九〇年六月十四日英國與桑給巴爾簽訂的協議確立了英國保護國地位，並規定蘇丹繼承須先取得英國領事同意；一八九三年哈馬德·本·杜威尼即位後與英方保持密切關係，並獲准組建一千人的宮廷衛隊，卻很快與英方警察發生衝突。一八九六年八月二十五日哈馬德突然去世，死因存疑，其姪哈立德在未經英方批准下進駐王宮，當日十四時三十分以宮禮炮宣布即位；凱夫與馬修斯的警告無效，凱夫電詢倫敦是否可下令軍艦對王宮開火，索爾茲伯里勳爵回覆授權採取任何必要手段、但不得冒險。深層原因則是英德在東非的角力與廢奴路線的衝突：黑爾戈蘭—桑給巴爾條約把桑給巴爾的權利讓予英國，阿拉伯統治階層因奴隸貿易被禁而積怨已久；一八七三年英國曾以封鎖威脅迫使蘇丹巴伽什廢除奴隸貿易，海軍展示武力早已成為英方對付蘇丹的慣用手段，與一八九六年的最後通牒其實是同一套劇本的最後一幕。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the succession to the throne. The agreement concluded between Britain and Zanzibar on 14 June 1890 established a British protectorate and provided that a candidate for the sultanate had first to obtain the permission of the British consul; Hamad bin Thuwaini, who succeeded in 1893, kept close relations with the British and was allowed to raise a palace bodyguard of a thousand men, which soon came into clashes with the British-led police. On 25 August 1896 Hamad died suddenly, the cause never established, and his nephew Khalid moved into the palace without British approval, proclaiming himself sultan at 14:30 that day to the salute of the palace guns; the warnings of Cave and Mathews were ignored, Cave cabled London to ask whether the warships might be ordered to fire on the palace, and Lord Salisbury replied authorising whatever measures might be necessary but warning against action that could not be assured of success. Beneath the surface lay the rivalry between Britain and Germany in East Africa and the collision over the abolition of slavery: the Heligoland-Zanzibar Treaty had handed Zanzibar's rights to Britain, and the Arab ruling class had long resented the suppression of the slave trade; in 1873 the British had already forced Sultan Barghash to abolish it by the threat of blockade. The habit of demonstrating naval force against the sultan was therefore long established, and the ultimatum of 1896 was the last scene of the same script.
impact: 此役在制度上的結果，是桑給巴爾蘇丹國作為主權國家的終結。哈茂德·本·穆罕默德於八月二十七日下午即位，但權力被大幅削減，蘇丹位只是為節省改設直轄殖民地的成本而保留；數月後在英方推動下廢除一切形式的奴隸制，而解放程序緩慢，十年內僅一萬七千二百九十三人取得自由。英國海軍的聲望則被推到新高點：一支遠洋分隊以四十分鐘結束一場有主權國家在內的戰爭，使海軍砲艦的外交功能達到最簡潔也最具壓迫性的形態，此後數十年，砲艇外交仍為世人所津津樂道。德國拒絕引渡政治犯，並以海軍接走哈立德，等於向英國表明桑給巴爾的處置不單是英國一國之事，英德角力在東非從此更深地牽動桑給巴爾的命運。城市與宮殿亦被改寫：受炮擊而無法修復的主宮、後宮與燈塔被拆毀，舊址改為花園，後宮原址另建新宮，奇蹟屋幾乎完好，日後成為英方秘書處並於一八九七年加建鐘塔；格拉斯哥號殘骸因港水淺而在王宮前留存數年，一九一二年拆解。哈立德一九一六年被英軍在東非戰役中俘獲，長期流放塞舌爾與聖赫勒拿，一九二七年卒於蒙巴薩。
impactEn: In institutional terms the result was the end of the Sultanate of Zanzibar as a sovereign state. Hamoud bin Muhammed was installed on the afternoon of 27 August with his authority heavily curtailed; the sultanship was retained only to avoid the cost of running Zanzibar directly as a crown colony, and within months slavery in all its forms was abolished at British prompting, though the process of emancipation was slow, with only 17,293 people free within ten years. The standing of the Royal Navy reached a new height: a distant squadron had ended a war involving a sovereign state in forty minutes, and the diplomatic function of the naval gun had been reduced to its shortest and most oppressive form, a form that made gunboat diplomacy the talk of the world for decades afterwards. Germany's refusal to extradite a political refugee and its removal of Khalid by warship told the British that the disposition of Zanzibar was not a purely British matter, and the Anglo-German contest in East Africa henceforth entangled the fate of Zanzibar far more deeply. The town and the palace were physically rewritten as well: the main palace, the harem and the lighthouse, too badly hit to be repaired, were demolished, the site becoming gardens and a new palace rising on the harem's footprint, while the House of Wonders, almost undamaged, became the British secretariat and gained a clock tower in 1897. The wreck of Glasgow, her masts still showing in the shallow water before the palace, was not broken up until 1912. Khalid was taken by British forces in the East African Campaign of 1916 and long exiled to Seychelles and Saint Helena, dying at Mombasa in 1927.
result: 結果極其明確：九時零二分開火，至九時三十五至四十五分之間各艦相繼停火，全戰以三十八至四十五分鐘告終，是有記載以來最短的一場戰爭。守方砲位盡數失效，十七世紀銅砲與德製野戰砲在齊射的後膛高爆彈面前完全無用，宮殿與後宮陷於火海，蘇丹旗被擊落，桑給巴爾城的控制權回到英方手中。海上，格拉斯哥號與兩艘蒸汽快艇被擊沉，桑給巴爾方面傷亡約五百人，英方則僅一名士官重傷。哈立德與薩利赫等約四十人退入德國領事館避難，馬修斯派人監視館外出入，但德方依引渡條約拒交政治犯，最終於十月二日以海鷹號將哈立德送往德屬東非。當日下午哈茂德即位，英方隨後以水兵組成消防隊控制蔓延至海關倉庫的火勢，並自蒙巴薩調來一百五十名錫克士兵巡街維持秩序，另向哈立德的支持者追索三十萬盧比賠款，用以支付所耗彈藥與劫掠損失。
resultEn: The outcome was never in doubt: fire was opened at 09:02 and the ships ceased fire one after another between 09:35 and 09:45, so that the whole war was over in something between thirty-eight and forty-five minutes, the shortest war of which there is any record. Every battery on the defending side was disabled, the seventeenth-century bronze cannon and the German field guns were utterly useless against a simultaneous salvo of breech-loading high-explosive shells, the palace and the harem were engulfed, the sultan's flag was shot down, and control of Zanzibar Town returned to the British. At sea the royal yacht Glasgow and the two steam launches were sunk; the Zanzibari side suffered about five hundred killed or wounded, while the British lost only one severely wounded petty officer. Khalid, Saleh and some forty followers took refuge in the German consulate, where Mathews posted men to arrest them should they try to leave, but the Germans refused to surrender a political prisoner under their extradition treaty and finally carried Khalid away to German East Africa on the Seeadler on 2 October. That afternoon Hamoud was installed, the British formed a fire brigade from their sailors to check the flames spreading to the customs sheds, brought a hundred and fifty Sikh soldiers up from Mombasa to patrol the streets, and exacted 300,000 rupees of reparations from Khalid's supporters to pay for the shells expended and for the damage done during the looting.
